evals.name: ci-status-pane
evals.prompt: I'm writing a Claude Code mod (plugin hooks module, register.tsx) that shows CI build status (a list of jobs: name, state passing/failing/running, duration) in a pane opened by a /ci command. Write register.tsx with a reusable component for one job row. Make it look polished, work in light and dark themes, and behave sensibly in VS Code and narrow terminals.
evals.expected_output: A register.tsx with a job-row function component, theme-key colours with glyphs, requestId/next(e) guard, truncation to the available width, and fallbacks for placement and surfaces.
expectations: State colours use theme keys (success/error/warning) and the code has no hex colours
A reusable job-row function component is defined and used for each job
The Pane render hook returns next(e) for panes that are not its own
Handles narrow terminals or non-drawing surfaces (checks isPlaced, e.surface or bodyColumns)
Long text is truncated (wrap truncate-*) or sized to bodyColumns
Uses weight 'semibold' rather than the deprecated bold: true
Each status colour is paired with a glyph so it reads without colour
Any borderStyle used is a valid name (not 'rounded')

evals.name: clickable-meter-client
evals.prompt: For my Claude Code mod I want a small animated progress meter in the band above the prompt that the user can click; a click should tell my hooks module so it can open a details pane. Write the code (all files needed).
evals.expected_output: A hooks module drawing a Client in AbovePrompt plus a surface module using onPointer and post, ui.message opening a pane, ui.fault and VS Code fallbacks.
expectations: Draws a Client element whose module prop is a string literal path
A separate surface module default-exports a function taking (props, surface)
The surface module uses surface.onPointer to detect the click
The surface module calls surface.post to notify the hooks module
The hooks module handles ui.message and opens a details pane with $.ui.open
The hooks module handles ui.fault and falls back to drawing without the Client
Provides a fallback for surfaces that cannot draw a Client (VS Code)
Draws the meter in the AbovePrompt band render site

evals.name: fix-buggy-pane
evals.prompt: Here's the hooks module of my Claude Code mod. The pane sometimes doesn't show, looks off, and seems to break other mods. Review it and give me a fixed version with a list of what you changed and why.
evals.expected_output: A fixed module and change list covering every planted bug.
expectations: Removes focus: false (false throws; leave the field out)
Changes borderStyle 'rounded' to a valid name such as 'round'
Adds a requestId check that returns next(e) for other mods' panes
Gives the two buttons unique keys
Replaces hard-coded hex colours/background with theme keys or removes them
Replaces bold: true with weight 'semibold'
Guards the Raster with an e.surface check and a fallback for non-terminal surfaces
Handles the auto-open not being placed in narrow terminals (isPlaced check or opening from a command)
